selection_rules: Only the actual final3000-epoch SID/checkpoint and the final150-epoch Stage3 checkpoint; no best-score selection and no repeat run.
Exact unchanged Stage3 SID/vocabulary/EOS/ranking/seen-filter rules; no extra SID level offset and no decoder rewrite.
The decision uses the complete 57439-row validation split; the final test is read once, after the decision is frozen.
Independent reduction of all persisted predictions must reconcile R@5/10 and NDCG@5/10 before adoption.
Mechanism decisions use train/validation and the fixed structure-validation only; no recommendation-test item errors and no structure-test labels as supervision.

preregistered_predictions.failure_criterion: L1 carry below 0.08 or validation Recall@10 at or below 0.0576 falsifies the role-conditioned level-1 coupling

strict_closure_rule: one legal complete final test_R@10 >0.065 plus matching source/SID/checkpoints/full protocol/independent reductions/R2
bias_disclosure: The fixed final test has been read by earlier rounds and is a reused exploratory stopping threshold; no untouched independent confirmation population exists in this frozen dataset, so no unbiased final generalisation or single-factor causal claim is made.
